title: A cold plasma's oscillation in particle-in-cell: the plasma frequency
source: Electrons of density n displaced from a neutralising background are pulled back at ω_p = √(n e²/(ε₀ mₑ)) whatever the wavelength (C. K. Birdsall, A. B. Langdon, Plasma Physics via Computer Simulation, 1991, §4-2; F. F. Chen, Introduction to Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion, 3rd ed., 2016, §4.3): 0.8979 GHz at 10¹⁶ m⁻³ (CODATA 2018 constants). Evaluated apart from the code under test

quantities.quantity: the frequency E_x rings at a quarter along the box (GHz), 10¹⁶ electrons per m³
quantities.reason: the grid's own oscillation: the charge assigned and the field gathered with the first-order shape, each sinc²(kh/2) at kh = 2π/32 (Birdsall & Langdon §8-6), Gauss's difference and the leapfrog at ω_pΔt = 0.052 put it 0.23 % low
